text:
marta: Heads-up — planning to flip feature flag `user-ml-routing` to `true` for a 10% canary today. Target cutover 12:45 UTC. Who's owning the deploy and smoke? Need rollback readiness. @kevin @ops_bot
kevin: I can do the deploy and run the smoke. I'll be on-call for the window. Give me the exact flip command and safe default.
marta: safe default is `false`. Use the flag-service API:```bash
curl -X PATCH https://flags.internal/api/flags/user-ml-routing \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"enabled":true, "percentage":10}'
```
jin: can we start at 12:50 instead? I have a sync until 12:30 UTC and need a 10-15m buffer.
kevin: 12:50 works for me, updating my calendar.
product_lead: Metrics to watch: latency p95/p99 for generation, overall error rate, fallback-to-base-model rate, cost per token delta. Also watch routing % in the dashboard. If any metric spikes >2% relative, rollback.
ops_bot: Smoke checklist:
```
- check /health on the routing service
- run quick prompt against canary cohort: `curl -s https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}'`
- confirm model selection logs show "user-ml" path for sample requests
- verify no auth errors in gateway logs
- validate metrics pipeline ingest for new cohort
```
marta: Rollback playbook: /playbooks/flag-rollback. Quick summary: flip `enabled` back to false, set percentage 0, and trigger immediate incident channel alert.
kevin: I'll post results in thread as I run checks. I'll also add a deploy marker.
deploy-bot: Deploy window scheduled by @marta for 1769457000 (12:50 UTC). Automated reminder will fire 5m before window.
marta: tagging @sam to watch dashboards during canary window. Sam?
sam: on it — I'll watch p95/p99, error rate, and the model fallback dashboard.
kevin: flipping to 10% at 12:50 UTC now. Command executed, response 200.
kevin: smoke run 1: prompt ok, generation returned, latency +7ms p95, no errors in gateway logs.
kevin: smoke run 2: ingestion confirmed in metrics pipeline, cohort tag present. Nothing alarming.
sam: seeing a small latency bump in p95 (~6ms) but within threshold. No error increase. Marking as green. :white_check_mark:
marta: thanks. We'll keep canary for 60 minutes, then evaluate to progress to 50% if stable. If any >2% error or sustained p99 increase, rollback immediately.
ops_bot: Reminder posted to #oncall and #incidents. Auto rollback not configured; manual rollback only.
kevin: noted. If we need to rollback, I will run:```bash
curl -X PATCH https://flags.internal/api/flags/user-ml-routing \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"enabled":false, "percentage":0}'
```
marta: all good — leaving thread open for the hour. Ping here with any anomalies.
kevin: final update at 13:50 UTC: canary completed, no regressions. Preparing rollout to 50% per plan.
product_lead: awesome, thank you team.
